summary: Frontend-only verification of Staff Dashboard date pickers (radar/pain/menstrual) and reactivated load charts (EVENT_MODE=false). Logged in as cristina.velez@brasillacrosse.com. All three date-picker calendar popovers open, allow picking a past date, correctly update their date captions, and disable future dates. All previously hidden !EVENT_MODE load charts now render across Short/Medium/Long Term tabs with seeded demo data and zero console/page errors. Training Load Monitoring 7d/14d/28d selector, team filter (All Teams → Women's → All Teams) and player filter regression all clean.
critical_code_review_comments: StaffDashboard.js is 2306 lines - large single file; consider splitting into per-tab sub-components for maintainability (not blocking).

DatePickerPopover uses bostonTodayStr() but 'disabled={(date) => date > new Date()}' uses local browser Date instead of Boston-today. In edge cases (e.g. late-evening browser in Asia) 'tomorrow Boston' could still be clickable and produce negative days_ago. Backend appears to accept days_ago freely; consider clamping to Boston today or clamping days_ago to >=0.

The '📅' caption near the Menstrual panel currently renders as an emoji-only text node ('🌸') followed by another node with '📅 2026-07-14'; consider making one combined caption to match the readiness/pain panel format for consistency.
Radar and pain panels expose quick buttons (Today/Yest/2d–6d) alongside the new Date button — verify design intent (both are present as expected per spec).
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded demo data (~12 days).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Staff Dashboard has 3 date-picker triggers: data-testid radar-date-picker, pain-date-picker, menstrual-date-picker. All open a react-day-picker calendar (button[name='day']) with future-date disabled. Load charts live in three tabs (Short/Medium/Long Term). Demo data covers ~12 recent days; picking older dates shows 'no data' captions (expected).
